answer: Proof of Stake requires agents to lock collateral within a secure digital vault to validate network transitions. This creates an economic plume of influence where voting power scales with capital rather than identity. By serving as a reliable beacon for truth, the consensus protocol ensures that any attempt to flood the system with fake identities forces an attacker to bear the prohibitive cost of slashing their staked assets, rendering the Sybil strategy mathematically irrational and economically unsustainable.
